method.files: manifest.files filtered by exact .js suffix; 643 unique paths
method.licenses: exact UTF-8 source slices from parsed copyright/license/preserve comments
method.consumerSignatures: actual directive markers and consumer arguments; ordinary prose, TSDoc param/returns and non-directive mentions excluded
method.anchors: first real token after the complete directive comment, index/type/value and following eight-token context; same-line directives also include their code-line tokens
method.nextLine: following-token start line minus complete directive comment end line; jest/no-commented-out-tests targets the literal immediately following commented-out test line instead, whose distance and text are compared; nextCodeLineDistance retained separately
method.nul: raw byte NUL offsets; both baseline and current must be zero

differenceClassification.explanation: HERECOMMENT 是源码注释。CoffeeScript lexer 为新增块注释保留额外 TERMINATOR 换行边界；按相同显著 token 的间隙逐项对齐，仅准许 TERMINATOR 插入。编译后 JS 的独立真实 token 与去注释 AST 同时相等，证明这些布局差异未改变运行代码。
